ns2:course.label: Advanced Personal Finance
ns2:course.description: Students will obtain practical knowledge and skills applicable to their daily lives, whether at home or in a professional context. Students learn advanced risk management, make informed investment decisions, navigate credit scenarios, retirement and estate planning, and work toward achieving their financial goals. Students will learn about current research on personal finance. The course includes an action learning component, allowing students to educate their peers and the community on advanced personal finance topics. Prerequisite: ACE 240 and a Quantitative Reasoning course.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ACE 240 and a Quantitative Reasoning course.
